title: Beyond Trajectory Imitation: Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.24064v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distilling reasoning capabilities from strong to weak language models typically involves imitating specific solution trajectories, effectively transferring what to answer rather than how to reason. This trajectory-level imitation encourages memorization of instance-specific steps rather than acquisition of transferable problem-solving skills, limiting generalization to novel problems. We propose Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization (SGPO), which replaces instance-level trajectory imitation with reusable strategy distillation. SGPO extracts structured strategy descriptions from strong-model responses and, for each problem, constructs both autonomous and strategy-guided trajectories to enable direct comparison of the model's behavior with and without strategic guidance. The framework then addresses two key questions. For how to distill, a token-level forward-KL objective selectively transfers the distributional shift induced by strategy

translated_title: 超越轨迹模仿：面向大语言模型推理的策略引导策略优化
translated_abstract: 从强语言模型向弱语言模型蒸馏推理能力通常涉及模仿特定的解题轨迹，这实际上传递的是“回答什么”而非“如何推理”。这种轨迹层面的模仿促使模型记忆针对具体实例的步骤，而非习得可迁移的解题技能，从而限制了对新问题的泛化能力。我们提出策略引导的策略优化，用可复用的策略蒸馏取代实例级的轨迹模仿。SGPO从强模型响应中提取结构化的策略描述，并针对每个问题构建自主轨迹和策略引导轨迹，从而能够直接比较有和没有策略引导时模型的行为差异。该框架随后解决了两个关键问题。对于如何蒸馏，通过词元级别的前向KL散度目标，选择性地传递由策略所诱导的分布偏移……
tldr: 该论文提出SGPO框架，通过从强模型中蒸馏可复用的结构化解题策略（而非逐实例模仿具体轨迹），显著提升弱语言模型推理能力对新问题的泛化性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SGPO, a framework that distills reusable structured strategies from strong models instead of imitating instance-specific solution trajectories, improving the generalization of reasoning capabilities in weaker LLMs.
